why_best: It provides an unmistakable, high-impact visual punctuation mark when a workspace experiences an unrecoverable crash or violent state change.
why_bad: A gentle dissolve or fade would make a terminal event look like a routine page load, stripping the moment of its critical urgency.
trap: A weak execution would linger on the post-impact dispersion for too long, turning an abrupt system shock into a sluggish particle animation.
